description: Defines the Minify_YUICompressor class for compressing Javascript and CSS using the YUI Compressor, including methods for minifying JS and CSS strings, handling external jar file and temp directory configurations, and constructing shell commands for execution.

classes.name: Minify_YUICompressor
classes.description: A class for compressing Javascript and CSS files using the YUI Compressor jar.

methods.name: minifyJs
methods.description: Minifies a Javascript string using YUI Compressor.

methods.name: minifyCss
methods.description: Minifies a CSS string using YUI Compressor.

methods.name: _minify
methods.description: Internal method to handle minification process for JS or CSS.

methods.name: _getCmd
methods.description: Constructs the shell command to run the YUI Compressor with options.

methods.name: _prepare
methods.description: Checks if jar file and temp directory are properly set and writable.
